differences.what: A's woofer is a flat, unshaded red disc with no cone, surround or dust cap, so it reads as a placeholder; B shows a real cone, surround and dust cap with a red trim ring

A's lighting is flat and low-contrast on a washed-out white sweep, so the clear red shell has no edges or depth; B's dark set with a rim and floor glow separates the silhouette and makes the tinted shell glow
B has a glossy floor reflection that grounds the product; A floats with only a faint contact shadow

B's horn carries a large blown pink highlight across its lower half with a hard wavy edge that hides the horn's form and reads as a CG environment reflection; A's horn is evenly lit and its throat and mouth are legible
A's internal bracing and corner joints are visible but murky and grey-tinted; B's interior panels are brighter and cleaner, though slightly overexposed salmon on the inner side panels
Both frames leave the product small and centred with large empty margins; neither has a lead line or crop that would hold a magazine spread
